creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers servers, hybrid cloud, networking and financing in detail and shows no creative activity; 'design' refers only to engineering and product design.

community.reason: Level 2: there is a named external STEM volunteer program with no reach figures, plus large employee development, but there are no external indicators to reach level 3.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current internal practices (pay equity reviews with pay adjustments and an Inclusivity Index) are disclosed without membership or reach figures.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: rests on general language only, namely small-and-medium-sized business customers, customer financing and the company's own innovation, with no specific enabling service for founders or small businesses.

evidence.activity: HPE STEM Discovery Program, in which employees volunteer to teach STEM and digital skills to learners in their local communities
evidence.quote: This program equips and enables HPE team members to serve as STEM education and digital volunteers in their local communities, exposing learners to cutting-edge technology and raising awareness about careers in technology.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Unconditional Inclusion

community.criterion: level 2: specific current named external education program, but no participant, volunteer or dollar figures disclosed

evidence.activity: Company-wide online and instructor-led training courses for employees
evidence.quote: Over the past year, our approximately 67,000 team members completed over 721,000 online and instructor-led courses across various categories, including leadership, inclusion, professional skills, technical training, and compliance.
evidence.indicators: approximately 67,000 team members; over 721,000 online and instructor-led courses

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size

evidence.activity: "My Success Plan" career-development conversations between employees and leaders
evidence.quote: About 94% of employees engaged in HPE’s “My Success Plan” program, which entails informal and formal 1:1 conversations with leaders, centered on performance, progress, and career aspirations.

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size

evidence.activity: Pay equity reviews with outside experts, with pay adjusted where gaps are found
evidence.quote: Where these reviews identify such gaps at a country-wide level, we adjust compensation to eliminate the gap.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Pay Equity

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current inclusive workplace practice, no reach figures for affected employees

evidence.activity: Inclusivity Index built from employee survey data to measure whether staff feel respected and valued
evidence.quote: We developed an Inclusivity Index using data from our Voice of the Workforce survey to help us measure important indicators, including how respected and valued all team members feel for contributing a broad range of perspectives and ideas.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Unconditional Inclusion

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current internal inclusion practice, limited reach disclosed

notes: The Networking segment sells 'education and training programs' to customers. This is a minor product-support service and was not scored as an education business. The 'Instant On' business appears only in the segment-realignment paragraph, with no description of what it does, so it was not scored for Entrepreneurship. 'Multi-language environments' and the 61% of revenue from outside the U.S. are international operations and do not count for Cross-cultural. The 'Unconditional Inclusion' label was scored only on the practices described. The STEM Discovery Program gives no participant or volunteer numbers, so Community stays at 2. The Item 7 excerpt ('foundation') is a trap usage and adds no evidence.
